[EN] Guerillas in the Mist
[ES] Guerrilleros en la niebla
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Be careful! The mist gives them a nasty temper too.
[ES] ¡Ten cuidado! La niebla también les pone de muy mal humor.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I only hope it will be enough.
[ES] Solo espero que sea suficiente.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Misted Hide
[ES] Piel nublada
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect misted hides from bloodhorn mugatos, stonebrow cubs, and curltress piglings near Scythera Fae.
[ES] Recolecta pieles nubladas de los mugatos cuernodesangre, cachorros cejapietra y cerditos rizoloco cerca de Scythera Fae.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the misted hides to Lidaera at Scythera Fae.
[ES] Lleva las pieles nubladas a Lidaera en Scythera Fae.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I hope it works."
[ES] "Espero que funcione".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
